title: Hot Nutty Irish Coffee
description: This hot, nutty Irish coffee recipe combines fresh, strong coffee, Irish cream, hazelnut liqueur, and a cinnamon sugar rim for a nutty after-dinner drink.
ingredients: 0.5 tablespoon white sugar, or as needed
0.25 teaspoon ground cinnamon, or as needed
1 fluid ounce Irish cream liqueur (such as Baileys®)
1 fluid ounce hazelnut liqueur (such as Frangelico®)
0.75 cup brewed coffee, or more to taste
1 tablespoon whipped cream, or to taste

steps.text: Combine sugar and cinnamon on a flat dish. Moisten rim of a mug; dip into cinnamon-sugar.
Add Irish cream and hazelnut liqueur to the mug; pour in coffee. Top with whipped cream; sprinkle with cinnamon sugar.
